# gcuany

> Cumulatively test whether at least one element in a one-dimensional ndarray is truthy.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var gcuany = require( '@stdlib/blas/ext/base/ndarray/gcuany' );
```

#### gcuany( arrays )

Cumulatively tests whether at least one element in a one-dimensional ndarray is truthy.

```javascript
var vector = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/vector/ctor' );
var BooleanVector = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/vector/bool' );

var x = vector( [ 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0 ], 'generic' );
var out = new BooleanVector( 4 );

var z = gcuany( [ x, out ] );
// returns <ndarray>[ false, false, true, true ]

var bool = ( z === out );
// returns true
```

The function has the following parameters:

-   **arrays**: array-like object containing the following ndarrays:

    -   a one-dimensional input ndarray.
    -   a one-dimensional output ndarray.

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   If provided an empty one-dimensional input ndarray, the function returns the output ndarray unchanged.

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var discreteUniform = require( '@stdlib/random/discrete-uniform' );
var BooleanVector = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/vector/bool' );
var numel = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/numel' );
var ndarray2array = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/to-array' );
var gcuany = require( '@stdlib/blas/ext/base/ndarray/gcuany' );

var x = discreteUniform( [ 10 ], 0, 1, {
    'dtype': 'generic'
});
console.log( ndarray2array( x ) );

var out = new BooleanVector( numel( x ) );
console.log( ndarray2array( out ) );

var z = gcuany( [ x, out ] );
console.log( ndarray2array( z ) );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
